Pluck needs Accessibility to notice your trigger (holding a modifier, a trackpad gesture, or a mouse chord) and to draw over other apps. It only listens; it never blocks or sends mouse or keyboard input.
Only if you turn on the optional real actions, Pluck uses Apple Events to open links and run a few system actions.
